lines.text: Okay Dad. Say something absurd, very calmly, like it is science.
The microwave is a time machine.
Tuesday, lasagna goes in the fridge. Thursday, it goes in the microwave.
Ninety seconds later, Tuesday is in my mouth. On a Thursday.
That is just leftovers.
That is what they said about the wheel.
Nobody said that about the wheel.
And the beep at the end? That is the machine. Being proud of the journey.
Dad, this is a little too good. My phone is already buzzing.
Okay, someone else. Calmer. Wronger.
I would like to calmly state that I am not bread.
The toast talks?
Only in the mornings. Go on, Sourdough.
Bread was my past. I went in soft. I came out with opinions.
You are literally breakfast.
I am a breakfast survivor. There is a difference.
Also, butter is a blanket. And I am always cold.
Three thousand people agree with the toast. In four minutes.
You cannot un-toast a man.
Pardon me. I also have a calm take.
Dad. Dad. There is a fox at the window. In a top hat.
That is Doug. He lives under the deck. Very polite.
Good evening. My take is that this house is in my yard.
The yard is in front of our house.
From under the deck, your house is my guest room.
We have been guests this whole time?
Since the summer. I chose not to make it weird.
Speaking of the time machine. I have one small correction.
Every Wednesday, the lasagna leaves the fridge. It comes back smaller.
Time travel takes a toll.
Or. Calmly. A fox comes in at midnight and has a little lasagna.
So the time machine is just you.
Calmly? Yes.
Okay. My turn. Very calm.
The dishes in the sink are Thursday dishes.
It is Tuesday.
Exactly. I already did them. On Thursday. In the future.
By your science, they are already clean. You just have not arrived yet.
That is airtight.
Calm. Clear. Slightly evil. I would rent her the deck.
So who washes them today?
Someone who is still living in Tuesday.
Forty thousand people say Dad does the dishes.
Forty thousand and one. I have no hands. I have a past.
I would help, but I am the landlord.
Fine. I will wash Thursday's dishes. Calmly.
Wonderful. And I will take the lasagna. To Wednesday.
Bread was my past. Dishes are your future, Marcus.
This is the best day of my life.
